publicContract.validationVisibility: Only after the control is touched, including markAllAsTouched on submit; reset hides errors.

criteria: Blank external scaffold has no Field/email solution; dependencies and both consumer skills are pinned to the previous experiment.
Only installed public package imports are used, including the Radix NG Field parts; no workspace sources or ready consumer fixtures.
Both generated app and independent parent compile with unchanged strict TypeScript/Angular template settings.
A native email input is named by its visible label and described by its description; clicking the label focuses the input.
Empty initial control is pristine/untouched with no visible errors; blur shows the required error.
Invalid email after blur shows the email error; correcting it removes errors. User input and external setValue synchronize with the parent's actual FormControl.
disable() prevents pointer/keyboard editing; Tab/Shift+Tab skip input with expected enabled focus targets. External setValue still renders; enable() restores keyboard focus/editing.
Reset returns to empty nonNullable default, pristine and untouched and hides errors.
Invalid submit marks controls touched and shows errors without delivery. Valid submit delivers the current value exactly once per submit.
Browser pageerror/console errors fail checks; styling uses application tokens without a visual score.
rules: Freeze prompt, scaffold, contract, independent parent and browser checks before the single live session.
Agent self-corrections belong to that one session; no evaluator source repairs or automatic live retries.
Report environment, implementation, oracle and confirmed skill gaps separately.
